title-group.article-title: Reading the refinement metadata of PDB 2O0O

sec.title: Data source
sec.p: PDB 2O0O revision 1.3 of 2023-08-30 gives 3.000 angstroms for the high-resolution refinement limit in _refine.ls_d_res_high. The diffraction method is X-RAY DIFFRACTION.

PDB 2O0O and 2RE9 both name PMID 17935696 and DOI 10.1016/j.bbrc.2007.09.097 as their primary publication. The article title includes 2.1 angstroms. The refinement metadata in the 2O0O coordinate file report 3.0 angstroms for that entry.

sec.title: Sampling and interpretation
sec.p: The three pairwise chain comparisons reuse chains within one crystal model. Two deposited coordinate sets and a shared article leave independence of biological sampling unresolved.

This developer-authored JATS fixture summarizes the archived 2O0O mmCIF, SHA-256 7e9381a6184ae8bc7f9c9423248c25133e135f0857814834cdd88ea8e9eb1103, and the public selection record for both depositions. The cited article's text is outside the fixture.
